reviews.title: Ads Ads AND ADS
reviews.text: Only played for 2 days! The ads are horrendous! When you pass a level, you have the option to get 10 coins for no ad, or watch an ad for 20 coins. EVERY SINGLE TIME you tap 10 coins for no ad, YOU GET AN AD NO MATTER WHAT! And some of the game play is not as advertised, as usual!!! Sick of these false advertising games. And NO, I’m not paying to not have to watch an ad. These games get enough money to run just fine. If nobody downloads any of these games from the ads, they get paid no matter what! Ridiculous!
